latest.description: ¿Es obligatorio ir a la universidad para desarrollar una carrera profesional en el ámbito tecnológico? Me hice esta pregunta una y otra vez allá por 2020, en plena pandemia. latest.description: The end of standard support for Amazon Linux 2 was June 30, 2026. If you are still running AL2-based Storage Gateway appliances, you are in the unsupported window, and here’s how to remediate: the method AWS supports, and the operational lessons that make it go smoothly.

latest.title: Secure Your AI Agents on AWS (Part 3): State, Communication, and Detection
latest.description: Part 3 of a three-part series mapping the OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications 2026 to AWS security controls. This part covers system-level dynamics: memory and context poisoning (ASI06), insecure inter-agent communication (ASI07), cascading failures (ASI08), and rogue agent detection and containment (ASI10).

latest.title: Secure Your AI Agents on AWS (Part 2): Tool Execution and Runtime Safety
latest.description: Part 2 of a three-part series mapping the OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications 2026 to AWS security controls. This part covers what the agent runs: tool misuse and abuse (ASI02), supply chain issues (ASI04), and unexpected code execution (ASI05).

latest.title: Secure Your AI Agents on AWS (Part 1): Inputs, Identity, and Human Oversight
latest.description: Part 1 of a three-part series mapping the OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications 2026 to AWS security controls. This part covers the agent's boundary with users and inputs: goal hijack (ASI01), identity and privilege abuse (ASI03), and human-agent trust abuse (ASI09).

latest.title: 7th Pillar of AWS Well-Architected: Value Realization
latest.description: We all know the 6 pillars of the AWS Well-Architected Framework. But is there room for a 7th? In this blog, I introduce Value Realization, a proposed pillar that shifts the focus from simply building well-architected workloads to delivering measurable business outcomes. Because a migration isn't successful just because it runs in the cloud. It's successful when it creates real value.

latest.title: Self-Healing Playwright: building a locator-healing wrapper with AI (Part 1)
latest.description: This article covers Part 1 of an AI-assisted project to build a self-healing wrapper for Playwright E2E tests. It explains why locators break during active UI development, introduces the HealingEngine's fallback strategies (data-testid, aria-label, placeholder, alt text, role, text, position), walks through the SelfHealingPage architecture and code, shares a working example, and closes with lessons learned and next steps.
